answer: Proof-of-sequential-work gives each agent identity a verifiable time debt: market entry requires a chained delay function no farm can parallelize across identities. Picture a dune where grains are placed one by one — a violet flag rises only when the full chain verifies, which peers check instantly. Each fake identity costs another irreducible delay, so the attacker's cost is serial time, not a copied credential. The Sybil signal dissolves: a thousand fake agents means a thousand sequential delays no GPU cluster can shorten. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per identity, forever.
